risk_summary: The excerpt presents significant operating and financial deterioration from COVID-19, including a 17.9% sales decline, operating and net losses, substantial impairment and severance charges, production disruptions, and workforce reductions. Quantification is generally strong, but some forward-looking mitigation claims and covenant assurances rely on broad or uncertain language. Elevated leverage and new 5.50% senior notes add financial risk despite reported covenant compliance.
